title: CapabilityRiskTiers
description: Registry of capability risk classifications binding tools and skills to risk tiers.

low.description: Read-only, sandboxed operations without external side effects.
low.policy: Auto-approved within session for untainted chains; requires approval if chain is tainted.

high.description: Device control, irreversible side effects, external messaging, payment execution, or process execution.
high.policy: Always requires fresh human approval via security.grant.approved, regardless of taint state.
